purpose: Teach: うたっ/短所/ふえる/ぼけ/なつ/やれやれ/人当たり/留まっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園で、うたった、お歌、本当に、上手だったよ、メイ姉さん、感動しちゃった、本気で。
lines.en: Sho, you sang so beautifully at the park today. I was really moved—I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely impressed. Lean forward slightly. The words come easily because the feeling is true. A small pause before 'I mean it' to show she's not exaggerating. Soft, affirming eye contact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの短所、教えてくれる?ぼく、本気で、直したいんだよ、本当に、頑張りたい。
lines.en: Mei-sis, will you tell me what I'm not good at? I really want to fix it. I want to try hard.
lines.style: Quiet and steady. The question comes from genuine self-awareness, not fishing for reassurance. Direct gaze. His voice doesn't waver—he's serious about wanting to improve, not apologizing for himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 家族、お祝いの席、ふえることが、最近、多いわよね、翔くん、嬉しいわよね、本当に、家族の絆、ね。
lines.en: Family celebrations seem to be happening more often lately. That makes you happy, doesn't it, Sho? This family bond—it's something special.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking aloud. Gentle cadence. She's noticing something tender about this moment. Not forced brightness—a real contentment in how she holds the thought. Slight trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、たまに、ぼけたこと、言うようになってきたんだ、メイ姉さん、心配なんだよ、本当に。
lines.en: Grandpa has been saying forgetful things sometimes lately. Mei-sis is really worried about it.
lines.style: Quiet and careful. The concern is real but he's not dramatizing. He's keeping his voice small because worry takes effort to contain. A little space before speaking—like he's been holding this for a bit.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: なつちゃんと、翔くん、お友達、なったって聞いたよ、メイ姉さん、嬉しい、本当に、絶対、可愛いわよね、ね。
lines.en: I heard you and Natsu became friends. Mei-sis is so happy about that. You two will be perfect together—I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Bright but genuine, not forced. A small laugh in the delivery—delight that's easy for her. She's rooting for him. Open, encouraging tone with a warm finish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やれやれ、宿題、本気で、多いんだよ、ぼく、メイ姉さん、手伝ってくれる?お願い、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Ugh, I have so much homework. Mei-sis, will you help me? Please—I really need your help.
lines.style: Light complaint at the start, but the plea underneath is genuine. Not whining—just tired and asking. A small hesitation before 'please' like he's gathering himself to ask directly. Hopeful rather than demanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人当たり、本当に、いい子だね、お友達、たくさん、できるわよ、絶対、メイ姉さん、信じてる。
lines.en: You're such a thoughtful person, Sho. You have such a warm way with people—I'm sure you'll have lots of friends. I really believe in you.
lines.style: Steady and sincere. Not flattery—observation delivered with quiet conviction. She's speaking from certainty, not reassuring doubt. Gentle pace. The last sentence lands with real weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんから、お土産、ぼくの机に、ちゃんと、留まってたよ、本当に、嬉しい、ありがとう、絶対、メイ姉さん。
lines.en: The souvenir you gave me is sitting right here on my desk. Thank you so much—I love it.
lines.style: Soft and touched. He's noticing the small proof of care. Grateful without being overstated. The words come easily because the gratitude is real. A tiny smile beneath the surface of the voice.
